name: CMMC 2.0 Level 2
description: Practices for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information across fourteen cybersecurity domains at Level 2.

requirements.title: Access Control
requirements.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes, devices, and approved functions.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the access policy and role design, then use current access review or authentication evidence to confirm operation.

requirements.title: Awareness and Training
requirements.description: Provide security awareness and role-based training to personnel with CUI responsibilities.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved training policy, assignments, completion evidence, overdue remediation, and role-specific content.

requirements.title: Audit and Accountability
requirements.description: Create, protect, review, and retain audit records for accountable activity.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the audit policy and use Splunk tracking to show source coverage, review activity, alerting, and retention.

requirements.title: Assessment
requirements.description: Assess and monitor security controls and manage plans of action for deficiencies.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the assessment scope and POA&M, then verify findings have owners, due dates, and current status.

requirements.title: Configuration Management
requirements.description: Establish and maintain secure baselines, inventories, and controlled changes.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use a configuration or asset dashboard to show baseline coverage, drift, approved changes, and exceptions.

requirements.title: Identification and Authentication
requirements.description: Identify and authenticate users, devices, and processes before access to systems and CUI.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use authentication tracking to show unique identities, MFA coverage, device trust, and exceptions.

requirements.title: Incident Response
requirements.description: Establish and operate an incident response capability for detecting, reporting, analyzing, and responding to incidents.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the response plan and confirm current alert, incident, escalation, and exercise evidence.

requirements.title: Maintenance
requirements.description: Perform controlled maintenance and monitor maintenance tools and personnel.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the maintenance procedure and sample records or logs for authorization, monitoring, and completion.

requirements.title: Media Protection
requirements.description: Protect and sanitize digital and non-digital media containing CUI.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review approved media handling, transport, storage, sanitization, and disposal procedures and records.

requirements.title: Physical Protection
requirements.description: Limit physical access and protect systems, facilities, and support infrastructure.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review approved physical security procedures and current access, visitor, environmental, and facility test records.

requirements.title: Personnel Security
requirements.description: Screen personnel and manage access changes when personnel are assigned, transferred, or terminated.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the personnel security procedure and sample screening, transfer, and termination records.

requirements.title: Risk Assessment
requirements.description: Periodically assess risk to organizational operations, assets, individuals, and other organizations.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the current risk assessment and register, then confirm material risks have owners and treatment decisions.

requirements.title: System and Communications Protection
requirements.description: Monitor, control, and protect communications at external and key internal boundaries.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use network tracking to show protected flows, boundary controls, encryption, and unresolved exceptions.

requirements.title: System and Information Integrity
requirements.description: Identify, report, and correct flaws, malicious code, and unauthorized changes.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use Splunk tracking to show vulnerability, malware, integrity, and remediation status for in-scope systems.
